hook: Hurricane Ian left his boat sitting in the treetops.
narration: Hurricane Ian left this boat sitting on top of the mangroves.
A man was still aboard, stranded in the flooded marsh near Sanibel, Florida.
A Coast Guard Jayhawk crew from Air Station Clearwater lowered a rescue swimmer on the cable.
He came down into the broken branches, right beside the hull.
A rescue basket lets a survivor just sit inside while the hoist does all the lifting.
The man packed what he could carry, then climbed in.
[short pause] Then the cable lifted him up and over the wreckage.
outcome: The Clearwater crew hoisted him up and safely aboard the Jayhawk.
title: Ian left his boat in the treetops
description:
After Hurricane Ian, a Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater MH-60 Jayhawk aircrew hoisted a man from his boat stranded in the mangroves near Sanibel, Florida, on Sept. 29, 2022.
